subject: Need Help To Load RODBC Package From Java

messages.author: e602756060d4367f
messages.subject: Need Help To Load RODBC Package From Java
parts:
hello,

I have a requirement to use RODBC package from R script. So I am planning to use Renjin to run the R script. So far I have done the following steps to do this.

1. Created gradle project with the following dependencies
     compile "org.renjin:renjin-script-engine:0.8.2506"
    compile "org.renjin.cran:RODBC:1.3-15-b11"
2. Created Java class with the following code
    
    RenjinScriptEngineFactory factory = new RenjinScriptEngineFactory();
    ScriptEngine engine = factory.getScriptEngine();
    engine.eval("library('RODBC')");

3. I did gradle build successfully, but when I run this java class I am getting the following error.

Caused by: java.lang.ClassNotFoundException: org.renjin.primitives.R$primitive$Sys$localeconv
                   at java.net.URLClassLoader$1.run(URLClassLoader.java:372)
                   at java.net.URLClassLoader$1.run(URLClassLoader.java:361)
Regards,
Chandra. A
J2EE Lead Developer.

Sorry for the late reaction on this. 

It occurs that the primitive function `Sys.localeconv` has not been implemented yet. It is on my TODO.list for another project that depends also on a package using that primitive.
